text:
If you've got outdoor plans for the rest of Thursday, don't scrap them, just keep an eye on the sky. It's mostly clear and 77 right now, but clouds build back in this afternoon with another round of showers and maybe a rumble of thunder, though nothing heavy, a tenth of an inch or so at most. The high holds right around 77, and honestly the models are split on how wet it gets: the American model keeps it fairly dry, while the European and other guidance lean much wetter, so I'd call it a coin flip and keep a rain jacket handy just in case. Showers taper tonight with lows near 62.

On the water, north wind 5 to 15 knots and waves a foot or less, with a slight chance of thunder this evening, so nothing that should scare you off but worth watching. The good news is Friday looks like the payoff: mostly sunny, high near 82, and a much quieter lake. If you can shift the big outdoor plans to Friday afternoon, do it.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST: BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) - Happy Thursday! We continue to hang on to a few leftover showers into this Thursday. The showers will become lighter and more scattered in nature this afternoon. Most of us will only look at another few tenths of an inch of rain through the day ahead.
